name: Bet Shemesh Engines Holdings (1997) Ltd
summary: Bet Shemesh Engines Holdings (1997) Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells jet engine parts in Israel, North America, Europe, Asia, South America, Africa, and internationally. It operates through Manufacturing of Parts and Engines segments. The company offers jet engine complex parts, such as compressor and turbine disks and blisks, frames, cases, air seals, spacers, turbine nozzles, and turbine blades; sheet metal parts and combustion chambers; and augmentor seals, flaps, and flame holders.
